text: I could not find a public source that directly reports the requested daily August counts. The closest relevant dataset I found is Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.3964990, which covers historical versions of English Wikipedia references only up to June 2019, so it cannot answer a question about June 2023 page versions. Wikipedia’s Template:Cite tweet docs confirm how Twitter/X posts are cited, but they do not provide any counts. Blocker: I would need an external dataset or code run over English Wikipedia revision histories for June 2023 snapshots to count citations by day of August.
